# Copilot project rules
- Keep `data/raw/` unchanged and out of Git.
- Validate joins and report row counts and order sums after each merge.
- Do not delete outliers or impute missing demand without a documented rationale.
- Do not use causal language for observational correlations or promotion comparisons.
- Cite the notebook/table source for every number in the client report.
- Include limitations and a measurable KPI for each recommendation.
